subject.title: Subagent process death emits no telemetry — sessions_spawn failures leave no span/trace

question: What stable diagnostics contract should OpenClaw expose for spawned subagent death or termination events?
rationale: The missing telemetry path is source-visible, but the event shape, OTel span relationship, privacy/cardinality rules, and relationship to the existing `subagent_ended` plugin hook are product/API decisions.

options.title: Add trusted diagnostic event
options.body: Emit a new low-cardinality trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and map it to diagnostics-otel spans/metrics with redacted identifiers.

options.title: Map existing hook in exporters
options.body: Keep core diagnostic events unchanged and have diagnostics-otel or external exporters subscribe to `subagent_ended` as the lifecycle source of truth.

options.title: Document hook-only contract
options.body: Declare `subagent_ended` the supported exporter hook and close the diagnostics-event ask after documenting how telemetry plugins should consume it.

recommendation.title: Add trusted diagnostic event
recommendation.body: Emit a new low-cardinality trusted diagnostic event from subagent terminal paths and map it to diagnostics-otel spans/metrics with redacted identifiers.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision mostly affects diagnostics-otel and telemetry contract shape, where Vincent Koc has the strongest recent history.
